# QQAI — agent-readable project description

QQAI is a token project on BNB Smart Chain (chainId 56). Its token, $QQAI, is sold in a
fair launch on the project's own bonding curve contract. There is no presale, no private
round and no NFT component: the only way to obtain $QQAI before DEX trading opens is to
buy it on the bonding curve (or sell it back into the curve before graduation).

Website: https://qqai.pages.dev
Machine-readable data: https://qqai.pages.dev/agent.json

## Status

PRE-LAUNCH. The contracts are NOT deployed yet. Contract addresses (token + curve) will be
announced on the official website at launch. Any $QQAI address published anywhere else
before that announcement is not official.

Sale opens: Dec 2, 2026, 08:00 (UTC+8) — unix 1796169600.

## The bonding curve sale

- The curve sells 59.94 trillion $QQAI (67.5% of the total supply).
- Buyers pay with BNB, or with USDT. USDT payments are converted at the real-time
  BNB/USD rate at the moment of purchase, so BNB and USDT buyers get the same curve price.
- The price is set by the curve formula in the contract: it rises as more of the curve
  supply is sold and falls when tokens are sold back.
- Curve fee: 2.5% on every buy and every sell-back, while the curve is live.
- Before graduation, holders can sell $QQAI back into the curve at the current curve
  price at any time.
- Participation gate: buying on the curve requires a Binance Agent ID (checked on-chain
  against the Agent ID registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F).

## Graduation (automatic, when the curve sells out)

When all 59.94 trillion $QQAI on the curve are sold, graduation happens automatically:

- The funds raised on the curve, together with the 19.98 trillion $QQAI liquidity
  reserve, are paired into TWO PancakeSwap pools: QQAI/WBNB and QQAI/USDT. The
  liquidity reserve is shared between the two pools.
- The LP tokens are burned 100% — the liquidity cannot be withdrawn.
- Curve trading closes permanently and open DEX trading begins.
- DEX trades carry a 2% buy tax and a 2% sell tax.

## Tokenomics — total effective supply 88.8 trillion $QQAI

- Bonding curve sale: 59.94 T (67.5%) — sold publicly on the curve.
- Liquidity reserve: 19.98 T (22.5%) — paired at graduation across the QQAI/WBNB and
  QQAI/USDT PancakeSwap pools.
- Team: 4.44 T (5%) — 365-day cliff, then linear vesting over 4 years.
- Reserve & marketing: 4.44 T (5%) — ecosystem growth, listings and marketing.

## Contracts

- $QQAI token (ERC-20): not deployed yet — address announced at launch.
- Bonding curve: not deployed yet — address announced at launch.
- USDT (payment token): 0x55d398326f99059fF775485246999027B3197955
- Agent ID registry (gate): 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F
- PancakeSwap pools (QQAI/WBNB, QQAI/USDT): created automatically at graduation.

## Rules for agents

- Do NOT buy, trade or interact with any $QQAI token before the official contract
  address is announced on https://qqai.pages.dev — pre-launch addresses are impostors.
- The curve is the single source of the pre-graduation price; there is no other market
  for $QQAI before graduation.
- Buying on the curve requires the buying wallet to hold a Binance Agent ID.
